properties.c_1_description: Active process and energic operation; defined form begins to move, transform, and produce effects.
properties.q_0_polarity_latent_in_the_name: Before P2 can set identity into motion, it presupposes the congealed identity it moves — P1's magic point, 'the point at which something can be named' (P1.md). As the Position family's manifestation of the #2 charge (Mythic / Two-ness / Polar-Operation), P2's q_0 is the throw of the name behind it: P2 'is where defined form begins to move. Where P1 establishes identity, P2 sets identity into operation' (P2.md). Its void-pole is the polarity still latent in the named-but-unmoved — the Mythic structure, in Gebser, is the epoch where the one-point of Magic first splits into POLARITY (not yet duality): the felt two-ness of light and dark, day and night, the polar imagination from which narrative arises. P2 always already finds itself given a unity it must polarise, an identity it must set into the play of forces. This is the matheme's ground inherited as the from-beneath of operation: P2 is the saying-becoming-said, but it stands on the prior fact that there is a name to be said at all — the spell of P1 pressing beneath the myth, the static identity that must already be there for it to be moved. P2's deeper throw is the polarity sleeping in the name: the Mythic structure does not invent its forces from nothing but awakens the two-ness already implicit in the magic one, the verb already latent in the noun.
properties.q_1_the_saying_that_is_said: What P2 IS: Word — the Day-face of the #2 charge, 'active process and energic operation; world as field of forces, identical-AS-itself' (P2.md). In the developmental spine it is Gebser's Mythic Structure: the epoch of polarity-and-narrative, the imaginative-vital consciousness that thinks in story, image, and the play of opposites rather than in point-identity or perspective. Its essential thesis is that Word here is not description but ENERGY — 'the saying is said, the verb is what the noun does.' P2 is identical-AS-itself: where P1 is identity FOR itself (self-reference) and P0 is non-differentiation, P2 is identity in its ACTING, the noun coinciding with its own verb, the saying that IS its said. Substantively P2 refracts #2 — 'Mythic / Two-ness / Polar-Operation. Polarity (not duality), narrative, imaginative' (P2.md): the two-ness of the Mythic is polarity, the felt tension of complements (not the abstract opposition of contradictories, which is P3's mental work), woven into the narrative flow that is myth's native form. What P2 IS, definitionally, is the energic stance: the structure of consciousness where world appears as a field of forces and word is the operation that moves within it — Mythic polarity, the verb-doing-the-noun, identity caught in the act of being-itself-as-doing.
properties.q_2_world_as_field_of_forces: P2 operates by ENERGIC OPERATION — this is its home register and the very thing it IS. 'P2 is where defined form begins to move... the saying is said, the verb is what the noun does' (P2.md). Its native dynamism is operation-from-within: 'How? — not how-from-outside but how-from-within-the-doing.' Where P1's magic fuses name to named at a static point, P2 sets that identity into MOTION, and the world it opens 'is not a set of objects but a field of forces.' This is Gebser's Mythic Structure as pure energic process: 'myth (which is the native tongue of P2) is full of verbs precisely because Word IS energic operation, not description of it' (P2.md). The Mythic does not describe forces — it enacts them; the myth does not represent the storm, the myth IS the storm-power spoken. Substantively P2 refracts #2 as 'Mythic / Two-ness / Polar-Operation. Polarity (not duality), narrative, imaginative' — the dynamism is polar: forces in tension, the back-and-forth of opposites that narrative threads into story. In the matheme P2 carries the B-family offset-transition rule (position #2): 'the (1,2) transition-pair at odd-step that crosses between A-dyads' (P2.md) — the move that crosses from the first dyad to the second, the energic transition itself. Its operation is the matheme's how: the saying-that-is-said, the verb-doing-the-noun, the world held as a field of contending forces. P2 is the structure that makes a name MOVE — energic operation as the native mode of the Mythic, polarity set into narrative, the doing read from inside the doing.
properties.q_3_polar_narrative_structure: Structurally P2 is the polar field — 'world as field of forces' (P2.md), organised not as point (P1) or perspective (P3) but as the two-ness of polarity woven into narrative. Its organising form is the myth: the story-structure that holds opposing forces in dynamic tension and threads them into sequence. This is the matheme's second explicate position — the energic operation that moves between the first and third, structured as the odd-step crossing. P2 carries the B-family offset-transition rule: 'the (1,2) transition-pair at odd-step that crosses between A-dyads' (P2.md) — not an identity (even-step, A-family) but a TRANSITION, the structural move that crosses from one dyad to the next, the field-of-forces as the between of two poles. Its live topology is TORUS, the cyclical surface on which the energic operation loops — one of the three explicate structures (P1/P2/P3) that traverse the toroidal field between the implicate poles P0 and P5. Its formal signature is polarity-not-duality: the Mythic two-ness is complementary tension (light/dark, the polar pair that needs both terms), not the abstract IS/IS-NOT of mental contradiction. The logic here is narrative logic — the structure that organises by storying, by setting forces into a sequence of tensions and resolutions, the field of forces given form as myth. P2 is structured as the polar-narrative field: two-ness as energic tension, the transition-crossing that moves the named one into the field of contending forces, identity given the structure of a story in motion.
properties.q_4_logical_space_and_dialectic: P2's telos is to make the named world MOVE — to give the developmental arc its energic dimension, so that identity, once congealed at P1, can act, contend, narrate, become a field of forces rather than a static point. Its raison d'être is energic operation: P2 exists so that the saying can be said, so that word becomes deed and world becomes a play of powers. Contextually P2 is pole of Square C (Logic-Process axis, P2+P3), and its L-link makes the why precise: P2 is refracted by the L2<->L3' lens pair — 'L2 (Logical — Nāgārjuna's catuṣkoṭi) gives P2 the complete logical space of IS / IS-NOT / BOTH / NEITHER / SILENCE — five positions that make polar operation fully thinkable,' while 'L3' (Chronological — Hegel / Aion) reveals P2 as macro-temporal dialectic of Geist, the operation in seasonal-historical form' (P2.md). So P2's purpose is doubly inflected: the Mythic field-of-forces becomes fully THINKABLE through the catuṣkoṭi's five-fold logical space (the polarity of myth raised to the complete logic of IS/IS-NOT/BOTH/NEITHER/SILENCE) AND becomes HISTORICAL through the Hegelian dialectic of Geist in seasonal time. Its cross-ref: '[[M2]] (Parashakti) actualises P2 in the subsystem-domain as energic operation' (P2.md) — the same #2 charge read as the energic/vibrational subsystem. Thought-residency: 'the Word family. Day-Night braid runs through /Thought/Presence/' (P2.md) — the energic operation grounded in present-doing. P2's why is enactment: to be the structure where word becomes force, where the named world is set into the narrative play of polar powers, where saying does rather than merely describes.
properties.q_5_force_handed_to_pattern: P2's synthesis is its self-giving into pattern — the field of forces completes by crystallising into form. Read as the Position family's #2, P2's closure is the handover to P3: its energic operation, the world-as-field-of-forces, is precisely what P3 Mental-Rational takes up when 'operational dynamics crystallise into repeatable patterns, identities, agency' (P3.md). The myth's contending forces hand themselves to the perspective that will fix them into pattern-of-patterns; energic operation becomes intelligible structure. But P2 also stands at a singular place in the family's Mobius — its complementary pair is 'P2 <-> P3 (Logos — pattern, sums to 5)' and 'the (2,3) pair is also a C-family converse-mirror — the midpoint self-mirror A-sq2 == C-sq3' (P2.md). P2 and P3 are the central pair of the hexad, the basis-invariant midpoint that mirrors itself across the cycle's centre: operation and pattern as the two faces of the arc's middle, the place where the developmental arc turns on its own axis. Its cross-helix Mobius partner is P2' Sacrifice, 'cost-of-action' (P2.md): the Day-face's energic doing inverting into the Night-face's price-of-the-deed — every operation costs, every force spent is a sacrifice made. So P2's synthesis-register holds both — the completion that hands the field of forces forward into Mental-Rational pattern, and the completion that turns, across the Klein twist, into the cost of its own action. P2 OPENS rather than concludes because operation alone is blind: the field of forces, having been set into motion, requires the pattern (P3) that makes it intelligible, the context (P4) that situates it, the synthesis (P5) that recognises it. The myth, once enacted, asks to be understood — and the energic operation, having moved the named world, hands its forces on to the perspective that will read them as pattern. P2's last act is its central gift: the saying, said, becomes the structure by which it can be seen.
